page_title: MCI 2-2 NOT | Manchester City v Nottingham Forest 04/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' Savinho (Manchester City) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
90+8' Manchester City quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+6' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
90+4' The referee gives a yellow card to Matz Sels (Nottingham).
90+3' Rodri (Manchester City) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.
90+1' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the right post.
90+1' Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Morgan Gibbs-White.
90' Vitor Pereira has decided to substitute Neco Williams and he is replaced by Morato (Nottingham).
88' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
86' The corner is swung in but Manchester City can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' The referee signals a substitution. Savinho (Manchester City) is brought on as a substitute for Rayan Cherki.
82' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
81' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
79' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a change. Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) replaces Igor Jesus.
77' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) replacing Phil Foden.
77' A substitution has been made. Rayan Ait-Nouri is replaced by Abdukodir Khusanov (Manchester City).

76' 2 - 2 Callum Hudson-Odoi passes to Elliot Anderson (Nottingham), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 2:2.
71' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
64' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
63' Substitution. Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) on for Nicolas Dominguez.
63' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) was probably a bit loose with his words to Darren England, who decides to show him a yellow.

62' 2 - 1 Rodri (Manchester City) jumped highest to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Rayan Ait-Nouri. His header was precise and ended up in the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 2:1.
62' The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
62' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
60' Darren England shows a yellow card to Murillo (Nottingham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
56' 1 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Igor Jesus and Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 1:1.
52' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
50' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

49' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Bernardo Silva (Manchester City), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Darren England has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' A cross by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
45+2' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
45+1' A yellow card for a tackle by Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham). Darren England doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' Close! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
39' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
38' The linesman raises his flag. Igor Jesus (Nottingham) is adjudged offside.
34' Neco Williams (Nottingham) is flagged for offside.
34' Gianluigi Donnarumma was forced to pull off a brilliant save to stop the effort from Igor Jesus (Nottingham).

31' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the left side of the target. The assist goes to Rayan Cherki and the score changes to 1:0.
26' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes a shot which is well saved by the goalkeeper.
23' Phil Foden (Manchester City) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Matz Sels is alert and makes a decent save.
22' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
21' Neco Williams (Nottingham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
19' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Matz Sels stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
17' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
15' Neco Williams (Nottingham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
15' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Rayan Cherki (Manchester City), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
13' Manchester City restart play with a quick free kick.
13' Dangerous play by Neco Williams (Nottingham). Darren England blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
7' Antoine Semenyo (Manchester City) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
6' An attempted cross from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is cleared.
5' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matz Sels, who smothers the ball.

2' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Gianluigi Donnarumma. This effort really didn't trouble him.
1' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Nottingham will have the kick-off.
Darren England was nominated as the referee for this game.
